title: Senior Data Engineer / Data Pipeline Architect
description:
**Senior Data Engineer / Data Pipeline Architect**
==================================================

**Location:** Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid – Travel Required)  

**Experience Required:** 5 to 10 years  

**Duration:** 6 months (Extendable)  

**Employment Type:** FTE  

**Working Mode:** Hybrid (Travel Required)  

**Language:** English  

**Start:** November 9, 2026 – April 30, 2027


We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer / Data Pipeline Architect for an assignment in Stockholm focusing on **data pipeline modernization, data security, and technical architecture**.


The assignment involves leading the technical migration of existing data pipelines to meet stricter requirements for **encryption, data retention, and deletion of user data**, including historical and derived datasets.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design and drive the architecture, migrating pipelines incrementally while ensuring **existing outputs remain unchanged**.
* Establish sustainable engineering processes for **testing, code reviews, incident management, and releases**.
* Combine architectural leadership with **hands-on engineering** using Airflow, Spark, dbt, BigQuery, and Python.
* Collaborate closely with and **mentor a Data Engineer** within the team, ensuring long-term ownership, reliability, and independent maintenance of the migrated pipelines.

**Must-Have Requirements**
--------------------------

* Minimum **5 years of relevant professional experience** (5–10 years overall).
* **Deep hands-on experience** with Airflow, Spark, dbt, BigQuery, and Python.
* Proven experience **technically leading at least one complete data pipeline migration** from start to finish.
* Experience **refactoring production data pipelines** while verifying that their outputs remain unchanged.
* Experience **establishing and implementing engineering processes** for testing, code reviews, and incident management.
* Demonstrated **mentoring experience with measurable outcomes**.

**Education**
-------------

* Minimum **Bachelor's degree** (or equivalent).

**Nice-to-Have**
----------------

* Experience with **encryption at rest, data retention, or data deletion compliance** (e.g., GDPR).
* Experience with **envelope encryption and key management** solutions (e.g., GCP KMS, AEAD functions, or Tink).
* Knowledge of **BigQuery column-level security, policy tags, and Data Catalog**.
* Experience with **Config Connector (KCC)** for managing GCP resources through Kubernetes.
* Experience with **event-driven architectures using Kafka**.

title: IFS Solution Architect - Novacura
description:
Vill du vara vår nyckelperson i att hjälpa våra kunder, industriföretag att ta nästa steg i sin digitala utveckling?


Vi söker en engagerad lösningsarkitekt med erfarenhet av **IFS Manufacturing** till något av våra kontor i **Lund, Göteborg** eller **Linköping**. Här får du en viktig roll i att forma smarta, moderna lösningar som gör tillverkningsprocesser effektivare och skapar nya möjligheter inom produktion, lager, logistik och service.


Tillsammans med några av Nordens mest innovativa industriföretag hjälper du verksamheter att få ut ännu mer av IFS Cloud – i kombination med Novacura Flow, vår flexibla low-code-plattform för att digitalisera och förenkla arbetsprocesser. Du blir en del av en framtidsinriktad utveckling där teknik och verksamhetsförståelse möts för att skapa verklig skillnad.

**Om rollen**


Du arbetar nära våra kunder med att utforma, införa och vidareutveckla IFS-lösningar inom tillverkning, försörjningskedjor och operativa processer. Som en uppskattad rådgivare hjälper du dem att omvandla sina mål och behov till skalbara lösningar som gör verksamheten starkare – både idag och i framtiden.


I projekten bidrar du till mätbara förbättringar: smidigare arbetssätt, bättre överblick, ökad mobilitet och högre operativ förmåga genom hela tillverkningskedjan.

**Det här kommer du att göra**

* Rådgöra kring bästa praxis för IFS Manufacturing
* Utforma och utveckla ERP-processer och lösningsarkitektur
* Leda workshops och fånga upp verksamhetens behov
* Bidra i införande, integration och löpande förbättringsarbete
* Driva digital utveckling med IFS och Novacura Flow

**Vi tror att du har**

* Erfarenhet av IFS Applications eller IFS Cloud
* God förståelse för tillverknings- och försörjningskedjeprocesser
* Bakgrund som ERP-konsult, rådgivare eller lösningsarkitekt
* Stark kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med olika intressenter
* Förmåga att koppla ihop verksamhetens behov med rätt tekniska lösningar

**Hos oss får du**

* Utrymme att utvecklas inom det du brinner för – och möjlighet att omsätta din kompetens i resultat som gör skillnad.
* En global utvecklingsroll i ett innovativt och snabbväxande företag i teknikens framkant.
* Konkurrenskraftiga förmåner och en ersättning som speglar din kompetens och prestation.
* Samarbeta med skickliga och engagerade kollegor runt om i Novacura.

**Om Novacura**


Vi utvecklar lösningar som hjälper företag att arbeta smartare och mer effektivt. Med vår egen plattform Novacura Flow och stark kompetens inom affärssystem hjälper vi kunder världen över att digitalisera och optimera sina processer. Läs mer på: **www.novacura.com**


Vill du vara med och skapa framtidens digitala lösningar för industrin? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig!

**Ansökan**


Låter det intressant? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Du är också varmt välkommen att kontakta oss konfidentiellt om du vill veta mer eller diskutera möjligheten innan du söker.


I denna rekrytering samarbetar Novacura med Raventor Headhunting och rekryteringskonsult Omar Burazerovic. Kontakt: omar@raventor.se alt. 0728–897441

**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**

title: Systemförvaltare till Utbildningsförvaltningen
description:
### **Beskrivning**


Vi på Utbildningsförvaltningen behöver förstärka enheten Stöd och utveckling. Vi söker dig som vill arbeta som systemförvaltare med ansvar för struktur, ändringshantering och tydliga processer.


Som enhet stödjer vi hela Utbildningsförvaltningens skolverksamheter med support, utbildning, utveckling och förvaltning. Vi har cirka 40 engagerade kollegor, men i just denna roll kliver du in som områdets expert och stjärna – du drivs av att självständigt strukturera, etablera processer och utveckla förvaltningen framåt.

### **Arbetsuppgifter**


I ditt uppdrag ingår att äga och driva förvaltningen av de centrala verktyg som lärare och elever möter varje dag: **Google Workspace for Education, Google Cloud och Digital Provtjänst**.


I rollen som systemförvaltare ansvarar du för:

* löpande användar- och behörighetsadministration samt uppföljning.
* information, introduktion och utbildning för användare och nyckelpersoner.
* framtagande av och underhåll av rutiner, instruktioner och förvaltningsplaner.
* insamling av utvecklingsförslag samt uppföljning av nyttan med systemen.
* testning av ny funktionalitet samt deltagande i change- och releasehantering.
* support- och incidenthantering samt eskalering till leverantör.
* säkerställande av informationssäkerhet, efterlevnad och gällande lagstiftning.


Du har ett nära samarbete med verksamhetens slutanvändare, vår egen supportorganisation, förskola, grundskola och Intraservice.

### **Kvalifikationer**


Vi söker dig som har relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet samt en stark förståelse för struktur, ändringshantering och processinriktat arbete. Du trivs i en roll där du får vara självständig och ta fullt ansvar för ditt område från start till mål.


Du är väl insatt i de lagar, regler och dataskyddsfrågor som styr skolans digitalisering. Som person är du strukturerad, utvecklingsorienterad och har lätt för att bygga förtroendefulla relationer med såväl pedagoger som tekniska experter.


För att verkligen lyckas och bli framgångsrik i rollen krävs det att du behärskar generativ AI som ett självklart verktyg i din vardag – där du aktivt nyttjar tekniken för att driva digitalisering, effektivisera arbetssätt och ständigt ligga i framkant i förvaltningsarbetet.


Du kommer att ha mycket kontakter både internt och externt och då är det viktigt att du har förmågan att utveckla ett bra samarbete med goda relationer.


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av systemförvaltning eller komplex systemadministration.


Det räknas även som en merit om du använder AI som ett naturligt verktyg för att effektivisera och utveckla ditt dagliga arbete.

### **Villkor**


Till din intervju behöver du ha med dig pass/nationellt id och eventuellt bevis på uppehållstillstånd om du har ett medborgarskap utanför EU/EES. Detta för att vi som arbetsgivare behöver säkerställa din identitet samt säkra att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige.


Med hänvisning till lagarna som reglerar registerkontroll så måste den som erbjuds denna tjänst uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregistret innan anställningsavtal kan upprättas.


Till de tjänster där det finns krav på utbildning kommer du som går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen att få lämna in underlag som styrker din utbildning, t.ex. legitimation eller examensbevis. Du kan även bifoga dem direkt i din ansökan.


Vill du veta mer om lön och våra förmåner? Du kan läsa mer om detta direkt på vår hemsida. Där hittar du också övergripande lönestatistik för de större yrkesgrupperna inom Göteborgs Stad: Förmåner och lön - Göteborgs Stad.

**Om oss**  

Vår vision är att Göteborg ska vara en internationellt ledande utbildnings- och kunskapsstad. Utbildningsförvaltningen i Göteborg bedriver verksamhet inom kommunal gymnasieskola, vuxenutbildning, yrkeshögskola, anpassad gymnasieskola, komvux som anpassad utbildning samt studie- och yrkesvägledning.  

  

I vårt arbete har vi ett tydligt elevfokus som sätter kunskap och färdigheter i ett sammanhang där inre motivation, medskapande och lust att lära är viktiga ingredienser. Vi arbetar utifrån alla människors lika värde och rättigheter. Tillsammans skapar vi en arbetsmiljö där både elever och medarbetare är delaktiga och verkar för varandras framgång.

title: IT-säkerhetsspecialist
description:
**IT-avdelningen** vid Stockholms universitet består av ca 120 medarbetare som har ett övergripande ansvar för Sveriges största universitetets IT-miljö. Det innebär bl a att utveckla/förvalta/driftsätta och övervaka plattformar, system och tjänster som stödjer akademi, utbildning, forskning och förvaltning.


Vill du arbeta i en miljö där kunskap står i centrum och där din expertis inom IT-säkerhet blir avgörande för att skydda forskning, studenter och samhällets utveckling?


Vi söker nu en IT-säkerhetsspecialist som vill bidra till att säkra Stockholms universitets digitala miljö – idag och för framtiden.


I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist ingår du i sektionen för Informations- och IT-säkerhet, SIITS, på IT-avdelningen. Du kommer att arbeta i en grupp som har fokus på IT-säkerhet och som arbetar för att hålla all IT på Stockholms universitet trygg och säker.


Sektionen ansvarar för att säkerställa att universitetets samtliga IT-system uppfyller ställda krav på IT-säkerhet, belysa eventuella risker samt utforma och införa tekniska eller administrativa säkerhetsåtgärder.  

  

I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist agerar du andra linjens stöd i IT-säkerhetsprocesser och arbetar taktiskt förebyggande och ansvarar för att analysera krav, utforma och införa rutiner, processer och anvisningar inom området.  

  

Du kan också komma att bidra som stöd och expert i det operativa arbetet med att identifiera, värdera, analysera och agera på cyberhot mot Stockholms universitet.


Mer information om oss finns på: IT-avdelningen.

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist ansvarar du för att:

* Delta i sektionens arbete med att stödja den operativa verksamheten med expertkunskap från en taktisk nivå.
* Samarbeta med IT-tekniker, Incident Manager eller andra team för att utreda och hantera incidenter.
* Utföra initial triagering och bedömning av potentiella hot, inklusive indikatorer på intrång (IoC).
* Kontinuerligt bevaka loggar, nätverkstrafik och säkerhetssystem (t.ex. SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR) för att upptäcka misstänkta aktiviteter.
* Underhålla och optimera SOC-verktyg (SIEM, logghantering, EDR, IDS/IPS) för bättre täckning och effektivitet.
* Stötta projekt och ärenden som har behov av IT-säkerhetskompetens.
* Vägleda och följa upp de åtgärder som vidtas med anledning av identifierade sårbarheter från t ex säkerhetsgranskningar i samarbetet med förvaltningsorganisationen.
* Bidra i omvärldsbevakning inom IT-säkerhet, analysera, förmedla och rekommendera relevanta säkerhetsåtgärder kopplat till aktuella händelser, hot och sårbarheter.
* Granska lösningsförslag och tekniska lösningar.

**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------


Vi söker dig som har:

* Akademisk utbildning alternativt av arbetsgivaren bedömd motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av IT-säkerhetsarbete där du har haft en liknande roll.
* Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat under press.
* Kunskap om logghantering, SIEM-verktyg och EDR-lösningar.
* Förståelse för vanliga attacker och hot (malware, phishing, DDoS, insider threats).
* Grundläggande kompetens inom digital forensik och incidenthantering.
* Förmåga att analysera loggar och identifiera avvikelser.
* Erfarenhet av Windows-, Linux- och molnplattformar (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud).
* God förståelse för nätverksprotokoll (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S).
* Goda kommunikativ förmåga i både svenska och engelska, tal och skrift.
* God förmåga att dokumentera och kommunicera.

*Meriterande:*

* Certifieringar såsom Security+, CEH, GSEC, GCIH, GCIA, GMON, GCDA, GSOC, GDSA, GCFR, eller liknande.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av incidenthantering, sårbarhets- och övervakningsarbete.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i en SOC, CERT eller liknande miljö.
* Tidigare erfarenhet som systemadministratör, nätverkstekniker eller liknande.
* Kunskap i script/programmering (t.ex. Python, PowerShell, Bash) för automatisering.
* Kunskap om ramverk som NIST CSF v2 och MSB:s metodstöd.
* Erfarenhet av offentlig verksamhet, gärna från högskola eller universitet.

*Personliga egenskaper:*

* Analytisk och problemlösningsorienterad.
* Förmåga att arbeta lugnt och metodiskt under press.
* Noggrann, strukturerad och dokumentationsvan.
* Samarbetsinriktad men även självgående.
* Nyfiken på nya tekniker och hottrender.

**Om anställningen**
--------------------


Anställningen gäller tills vidare på heltid med sex månaders provanställning. Stockholms universitet tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

**Vi erbjuder**
---------------


Hos oss får du dynamiken i samspelet mellan högre utbildning och forskning som gör Stockholms universitet till en spännande och kreativ miljö. Du arbetar i en internationell miljö och får förmånliga villkor. Universitetet ligger beläget i Nationalstadsparken med goda förbindelser till city.


Stockholms universitet värnar om att vara en arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika rättigheter och möjligheter för alla.

**Kontakt**
-----------


Ytterligare information lämnas av informationssäkerhetschef Fredrik Bolinder, fredrik.bolinder@su.se.

**Ansökan**
-----------


Du söker anställningen via Stockholms universitets rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande ansvarar för att ansökan är komplett och att den är universitetet tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdag.


Anvisningar för sökande finns på webbsidan: att söka en anställning.


Stockholms universitet bidrar till det hållbara demokratiska samhällets utveckling genom kunskap, upplysning och sanningssökande.

title: Professional Software Engineer
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.


Join us in shaping the next evolution of manufacturing software.

  

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help evolve one of Volvo Group's most business-critical digital products, supporting manufacturing operations across multiple production sites. You'll join the product at a unique point in its journey, where you'll help improve today's solution while influencing its technical direction for years to come.

  

The product has successfully supported manufacturing operations for many years and is now entering its next phase. Our ambition is to continuously introduce new capabilities, service-based architecture, modern engineering practices and technologies that enable automation, intelligent services and future innovation, while maintaining the stability that manufacturing depends on.  

If you enjoy understanding complex systems, improving them incrementally, and helping shape what comes next, we'd like to hear from you.

**What you'll do**

  

Together with developers, architects and the Product Owner, you'll contribute to the product's long-term technical direction by:  

* Designing, developing and maintaining business-critical software
* Modernising existing capabilities through incremental improvements rather than large-scale rewrites
* Designing and developing new services, APIs and capabilities as the product evolves
* Improving reliability, maintainability and performance
* Designing solutions that enable automation, data-driven decision making and future intelligent capabilities
* Supporting architectural decisions and technical investigations
* Coaching colleagues through technical leadership and code reviews
* Helping strengthen engineering practices and technical foundations that support continuous improvement
 **Who are you?**

* You're an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving difficult technical challenges.
* You appreciate the value of existing software while recognising opportunities to improve it.
* You understand that successful modernisation isn't about replacing everything, it's about making thoughtful engineering decisions that create long-term value.
* You’re collaborative and comfortable working across different technologies and generations of software
* You enjoy learning, sharing knowledge and helping both products and people evolve over time.
**What you'll bring**

  

We’re looking for someone with strong experience in several of the following areas:

 **Software Development & Architecture**  

Experience with C#/.NET, including .NET Framework 4.8, .NET Core and Windows Forms, as well as Java. You should have understanding of object-oriented design, API development using technologies such as WCF and REST, and software architecture and design principles.

**Databases & Data Management**

title: Entry Level: 6G Baseband Software Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------


**About this opportunity**

  

Forty percent of the world's mobile traffic is carried over Ericsson networks. Nobody thinks about that until it stops. A mobile network is how people call an ambulance, pay for lunch or find each other — invisible when it works, national news when it fails. That is the scale that a single line of our baseband code operates on.


We are now entering the 6G program, building it in Lund as a product heading for its first release. This is not a research demo, not a paper, but software that ships to the end user for real world applications. Decisions around how 6G technology operates are still open to explore. A radio has a fixed amount of time, spectrum and processing to spend, and it now has much more than one job to execute. Join in three years and you inherit this technology— join now, and you will be a part of shaping it.


We are looking for newly graduated engineers at the start of their career to build the first 6G product with us.

 **What you will do**

  

You will join a cross-functional team working in baseband software development: in the physical layer, where radio energy becomes data, and in the Layer 2 uplink and downlink processing chains that schedule and move user data. We will not pretend there is a long 6G delivery history to join; there is not. That is the point, and it is what makes this different from maintaining something finished.


The difficulty is real, and it is specific. Real-time C and C++ under microsecond deadlines, against 3GPP specifications, on multi-core DSPs, is unforgiving work. The same capability must also hold on two very different machines: Ericsson's own many-core baseband hardware, and standard commercial servers. What is cheap on one is expensive on the other. Making a single design work on both is an open problem here, not a solved one you would be maintaining.


We treat working with AI as an engineering skill to be learned rather than a tool to be handed out, and the scarce part of that skill is judgment: knowing which answer to trust, which to verify, and which to throw away is key.

 **The craft itself is classic baseband engineering, and it looks like this:**


Take a feature from a question to shipped code — studies, systemization, design, implementation, test.


Read the 3GPP specification behind it and turn that into something a radio can actually meet.


Rework parts of a baseband that has shipped to hundreds of networks so that it carries 6G, without breaking what runs today.


Work against a standard that is still moving, and feed what you learn back into it.


Explore parts of a C++ code base far larger than anything at any university and find the three lines that matter.


Test it, improve the test environment you need in order to test it, and hunt the bugs that only appear on real hardware.

 **The skills you bring**

  

An MSc in computer science, electrical engineering, engineering physics, wireless communication or similar.


C or C++ close to the hardware, and enough mathematics to be unafraid of a signal.


Something you have initiated or taken ownership of, in your studies, at work, or in your own time.


Comfort working where the answer is not known yet. Much of this has not been done before, by anyone.

  

You do not need to be an expert in telecom — several people on these teams arrived from entirely different domains. We will teach you the standard; we cannot teach you curiosity.

  

Sounds like your kind of problem? Apply now!

**Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.  

  

**What happens once you apply?**Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

 **Primary country and city:** Sweden (SE) || Lund

description:

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


Intill Resecentrum ligger Scandic Örebro Central, mitt i en expansiv och växande stadsdel där hotellet utgör en naturlig mötesplats och knutpunkt. Hotellet erbjuder 160 rum och öppnade i mars 2022. Ett par stenkast från hotellentrén anländer tåg från alla väderstreck och länkar ihop den gamla skostaden med Stockholm, Oslo och Göteborg. Genomgående för det nya kvarteret är hållbart byggande, vilket letar sig in i Scandic Örebro Central i allt från konstruktion och hotellrum till mat och dryck. Hotellet är ett intimt, flexibelt och levande hotell med ett hjärta som bultar för personlig service. Lobbyn är utformad som ett vardagsrum, avdelat med gröna gardiner av växtlighet och strösslat med mjuka fåtöljer och bekväma stolar för att bjuda in till lika delar arbete och fritid.


Här kan våra gäster koppla av med en bit mat, dricka något gott eller ta ett digitalt möte. I den varma, öppna lobbyn samsas hållbara material med tidlösa värden och nytänkande designlösningar.


**Nu söker vi en Receptionist till Scandic Örebro Central från januari 2027**


Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.


Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!


Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**


Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud samt administrativa uppgifter kopplade till gäster och säkerhet. Eftersom bar och restaurang ligger i direkt anslutning till receptionen arbetar vi nära varandra över avdelningsgränserna, vilket innebär att du vid behov även stöttar upp med enklare arbetsuppgifter i baren, såsom att servera mat och dryck. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet, flexibilitet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift vid behov (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**


För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.


Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid och arbetstiderna är förlagda enbart till kvällar.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.


Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!


Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Project Manager
description:
**Join PDSVISION – Lead the Digital Transformation Journey as a Project Manager**


Are you an experienced Project Manager passionate about delivering impactful enterprise system solutions? PDSVISION is expanding in the Nordic region, and we’re looking for a dynamic Project Manager to lead complex customer implementation projects across the PTC, Ansys, and PDSVISION product portfolios

 **About Us**


PDSVISION is a global technology partner helping companies successfully navigate their digital transformation journeys. We specialize in:

* 3D Design (CAD)
* Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
* Product Data Management (PDM)
* Simulation & Modeling (CAE)
* Internet of Things (IoT)
* Augmented Reality (AR)
* Aftermarket Solutions


With offices across Europe and the US, and partnerships with industry leaders PTC and Ansys, we support over 950 customers globally—from innovative local firms to large multinational enterprises.

 **Your Role: Project Manager**


As a Project Manager, you’ll be the driving force behind the successful delivery of enterprise-level system implementation projects. You’ll manage cross-functional teams, oversee timelines and budgets, and ensure projects deliver real value to our customers.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of customer projects involving PLM, CAD, CAE, and related enterprise systems
* Own project planning, resource coordination, risk management, and stakeholder communication
* Collaborate closely with technical consultants, architects, and customers to align solutions with business goals
* Maintain strong customer relationships and act as the primary point of contact throughout the project lifecycle
* Facilitate post-implementation reviews to capture learnings and continuously improve delivery practices
* Contribute to the development and refinement of internal project methodologies and best practices

 **What’s in it for you**


Many of our employees have been with us for a long time, mainly because of what we offer:

* **A clear career path:** We have a solid plan to help you grow and take the next steps in your career.
* **Continuous learning and mentorship:** You’ll be supported by experienced colleagues who guide you through training, certifications, and real-world challenges that broaden your skills.
* **A strong professional network:** Build valuable connections with peers, experts, and a wide range of companies, from global enterprises to innovative local firms across our 950+ customers.
* **Technical variety:** Work hands-on with a diverse mix of technologies including, large-scale PLM enterprise systems, databases, on-premise and cloud servers, and Active Directory.
* **A knowledge-sharing culture:** Join a team that values collaboration and continuous improvement, where you’ll grow both technically and as a trusted advisor to our customers.

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience as a Project Manager in enterprise system implementation projects (e.g., PLM, ERP, CAD, CAE)
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel, while keeping stakeholders engaged and informed
* Solid understanding of IT systems and software delivery, ideally in industrial or engineering contexts
* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills
* Collaborative mindset and ability to navigate diverse technical and business environments
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

**Bonus if you also have experience with:**

* PTC Windchill, Creo, or Ansys solutions
* Agile or hybrid project methodologies
* Working in multi-vendor or multi-system customer environments
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2 or Scrum Master

**Other Information:**  

Full-time probation period for 6 months to move over to permanent employment.

**Salary:**  

Individual salary dependent on skills and experience

**Excited?**  

Please apply for the job here.


Recommendations, resumes and diplomas should be brought if you are selected for an interview. We will not contact your current employer without your consent.


PDSVISION does not offer sponsorship to non-European applicants.

title: Engineering Manager - Financial Controlling / Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**Job Description**  

Join H&M Tech and shape the digital backbone of Finance.


The role sits within the Finance Area in the Corporate domain, where we combine business expertise and modern technology to build scalable, compliant and efficient solutions for core finance processes.


The role is dedicated to one product: Financial Controlling/Financial Planning & Analysis, which enables fast, reliable and transparent financial steering for Controlling, the CFO and CIO Offices, Accounting and Store Management. It covers financial reporting and analytics, daily turnover follow-up, planning and forecasting, and tech finance data, cost transparency and allocation.


As Engineering Manager, you will lead the product’s technical delivery and operations. You will partner with the Product Manager, who owns the roadmap, and work closely with Controlling, architecture and engineering teams to turn complex needs into reliable digital solutions. You’ll lead through technology, direction and collaboration, not through direct staff responsibility.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will lead the product across three delivery teams of H&M engineers, consultants and business experts:

* Supporting financial reporting, analytics and daily turnover
* Supporting planning, forecasting and investment planning
* Supporting Tech Financial – tech finance data, cost transparency and allocation

**Delivery and roadmap**

* Lead end-to-end technical delivery, from financial data and reporting to planning and tech cost transparency.
* Partner with the Product Manager and Finance stakeholders on roadmap, priorities and releases, bringing technical feasibility and trade-off insights.
* Ensure the teams have the right skills, capacity and partners to deliver on agreed priorities.
* Own delivery quality across initiatives, continuous improvement (CI) and run, including timely execution of prioritized features and epics.
* Ensure solutions are well documented, with AI readability and automation in mind.

**Operational excellence**

* Be accountable for the product’s health, monitoring, stability, security and scalability, including incident handling in key periods such as budget and forecast cycles.
* Champion data quality and trusted, consistent financial data.
* Drive simplification, automation and continuous improvement in line with tech strategy, architecture standards and engineering guardrails.
* Follow up delivery and performance KPIs, and proactively manage risks, dependencies and technical debt.

**Technical leadership**

* Set technical direction for a landscape that currently combines cloud-native solutions in Microsoft Azure with SaaS platforms such as Anaplan and Apptio.
* Uphold engineering standards across architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, security and compliance, balancing delivery speed with technical health and long-term scalability.
* Work with solution and enterprise solution architects and lead engineers on solution design, ensuring coherence with adjacent products and the long-term target state.

**Collaboration, partners and financial accountability**

* Act as the main tech contact for the product, working closely with the Product Manager, Controlling and other Finance stakeholders.
* Collaborate with other tech functions, such as platform, data and AI teams, to solve cross-domain challenges.
* Own collaboration with vendors and service providers, including SaaS and managed service contracts, to ensure short- and long-term stability.
* Be accountable for the product’s tech costs (budget, actuals and forecast), with a focus on cost efficiency and total cost of ownership.
* Share clear updates on status, progress, risks and dependencies.

**Team and culture**

* Build a high-performing, inclusive and psychologically safe culture across the teams.
* Coach engineers and partners to grow and perform and drive continuous improvement in ways of working and engineering practices.
* Plan and contribute to team development together with other Engineering Managers and Competence Managers.

 **WHO YOU ARE**


You are an engineering leader who combines technical depth, delivery focus and collaboration. You enjoy working close to the business and know that trusted data and stable solutions come from engineering discipline, learning and simplification.

* Experience as a senior software engineer and/or in technical solution leadership, with several years in senior or lead roles leading teams through major deliveries.
* Experience leading technical delivery in a product-oriented environment, in close partnership with product and business.
* Solid understanding of architecture, scalable design, cloud fundamentals and modern engineering practices such as agile, DevOps and CI/CD.
* A DevOps mindset and a track record of building and running stable products, including RUN, delivery, security, monitoring and incident management.
* Comfortable with complex business processes, ideally within finance, controlling, planning, reporting, analytics or regulated environments. Experience with data warehousing, BI or planning platforms such as Anaplan is a plus.
* Financial acumen and experience managing tech budgets and forecasts, as well as vendors, consultants and SaaS partners.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence without formal people management responsibility.
* Clear, collaborative and pragmatic — you balance speed, quality, risk and long-term value, and turn complexity into action.
* A genuine drive to lead, develop and build strong teams and culture.
* Curious about how technology, automation, data and AI can create better experiences and decisions.


At H&M Tech, you’ll help build the finance capabilities that keep the business moving, creating solutions that are simple, scalable and ready for what’s next.

 **WHO WE ARE**


H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

 **WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**


At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

* Staff discount card: Usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.
* H&M Incentive Program (HIP): Included in our HIP.
* Competitive pensions: Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to the Swedish market.
* Generous vacation: 30 days' vacation, health care allowance, and good work-life balance.
* Additional perks: Discounts from Benify.
* Global impact: Be part of a team that influences users worldwide.
* Professional growth: Endless opportunities to learn and develop your skills.
* Collaborative culture: Join a motivated team that values collaboration and excellence.

 **JOIN US**


Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.


This is a full-time permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to the agreement. The role is based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden.


Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through the career page.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!

* We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Product Marketing Operations Manager | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.



We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.



You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.


**The Opportunity:**



Product Marketing at Grafana Labs lives in the Product org, not the Marketing org, and we think differently about the job. As Grafana's offering shifts from dashboards to observability agents, our team closes the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. We build clear, consistent positioning, run marketing campaigns that attract new customers, and create content that helps engineering teams see why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.



Rather than only executing launches and campaigns, we teach Grafana’s product managers and engineers how to think about growth and demand. We also codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone at Grafana can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.



The Operations Manager keeps the Product Marketing *system* running and makes it better. You'll track how our work performs and report on it to the team every week, experiment with new AI workflows, and maintain the collateral and tools the team and the field depend on, so the sales team is fully supported in positioning our products. You'll work closely with the team's software engineers: you test ideas like sales deck generators or tools for competitive analysis, script prototypes, and define what good output looks like, and they turn the best ideas into production tools. You'll also coordinate with the field, Enablement, and Marketing so we understand each other's goals and make progress on shared initiatives.



For this role you don't need to be a product marketer but you should have experience working inside a Product or Marketing organization for a software company. Since we don’t have an operations manager yet, you’ll also help to shape your own role. You should arrive with a desire to find and solve imperfectly-defined problems.


**What You'll Be Doing:**


* **Projects and Cross-Functional Initiatives**: Drive cross-functional initiatives that align with product marketing strategies across GTM, Product, and Marketing teams. Own follow-ups, task tracking, and on-time completion.
* **Cross-Team Coordination**: Coordinate with the field, Enablement, and Marketing teams so we understand each other's goals and priorities. Track shared initiatives, and coordinate enablement activities with the Enablement team.
* **Analytics and Reporting**: Track the product marketing team's key metrics, such as how our content, enablement sessions, and launches perform and who uses them. Interpret and report on them to the team every week.
* **AI Experimentation and Prototyping**: Try out new AI workflows and tools, using AI to write scripts and checking that they work. Decide what good output looks like and codify that judgment in evaluations, working alongside the software engineers on our team as they refine and deploy tools. Hand the most promising prototypes to engineers to make production-ready. For example, you might test a deck generator with sellers, write evals for it, and communicate about it internally.
* **Collateral Management**: Maintain the team's most important collateral, including core decks, positioning content, and enablement sessions. Keep it accurate and current, share it widely, and make sure sellers know where to find it and how to use it.
* **Knowledge Base Stewardship**: Help keep our shared product knowledge base complete and current. Spot missing or stale information, chase down the owners, and improve the processes that keep it up to date.


**What Makes You a Great Fit:**


* 2+ years in an operations, analytics, enablement, or technical support role within a Product or Marketing organization for a software company.
* Strong analytical judgment: you use AI and other tools to pull data, check the results instead of taking them at face value, and turn the numbers into clear recommendations
* Proficiency with AI agents, including building skills and automated workflows that more than one person uses
* Good judgment about what makes AI output good, and the ability to codify that judgment in evaluations
* Ability to quickly understand our products and describe their value: what SREs and platform engineers do, and how observability products help them
* Ability to build dashboards and pages in Grafana, or to learn quickly
* Strong project management and organizational skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including presenting data to a team


**Bonus Points For:**


* Strong bias to action: you build, test, and ship instead of waiting for permission
* Able to manage multiple projects and priorities at once
* Adaptable, flexible, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
* High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills
* Our team knows its goals and can see its progress toward them
* More people outside the team use our AI tools and collateral
* Collaboration with the field, Enablement, Marketing, and other partner teams runs more smoothly, leading to better working relationships and more impact across the org


**Compensation & Rewards:**



In Sweden, the base compensation range for this role is SEK 640,484 - SEK 768,580. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.


* *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.*


**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**


* **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* **Open Source Roots** – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* **In-Person onboarding** - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* **Balance is Key** - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.*


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*


*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*



#LI-Remote



*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

title: Thesis Worker - Accelerating Software Development with AI: Productivity and Quality in TRATON One OS
description:
**30 hp - Accelerating Software Development with AI: Productivity and Quality in TRATON One OS**

  

**Introduction**  

Are you interested in exploring how Artificial Intelligence can transform the way software is developed for next-generation vehicles?

  

We are looking for **two Master's students** to jointly investigate how AI-assisted development can accelerate software engineering while maintaining high standards of quality. The project will be carried out within TRATON R&D, working with engineers developing TRATON One OS (TOOS), the software platform for future generations of TRATON vehicles.

  

**Background**  

As vehicles become increasingly software-defined, efficient development and reliable software quality are more important than ever. TRATON One OS is a key part of this transformation, providing a common software platform across the TRATON Group.

  

Recent advances in generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) offer exciting opportunities to support software development, from translating functional requirements into executable code to generating and evaluating automated tests.

  

However, generating code faster does not necessarily mean delivering working software faster. AI-generated solutions still require verification, integration, review and potentially significant rework.

  

This thesis explores how AI can be applied across the development workflow and, importantly, how its actual benefits can be measured.

  

**Objective**


The objective is to investigate whether AI-assisted development can reduce the total engineering effort required to implement and test software functions within TOOS, while meeting the same predefined software quality criteria as conventional development.

  

The central research question is:


**How much can AI assistance accelerate the development of software functions, from functional description to tested implementation, without compromising software quality?**


The study will evaluate both productivity and quality, including development time, testing effectiveness, defects, and the effort required for human review and corrections.

  

**Job description**


The two students will jointly design, implement and evaluate an AI-assisted software development workflow using representative functions from the TOOS environment.

  

The work will include:


* Investigating existing development practices and relevant AI-assisted software engineering techniques.
* Selecting and modeling a limited set of representative software functions, including requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Developing a prototype workflow using approved AI tools to support implementation, test generation and review.
* Comparing conventional and AI-assisted development approaches using equivalent requirements and quality criteria.
* Evaluating total engineering effort, software correctness, requirements coverage, test effectiveness and necessary human intervention.
* Investigating how the approaches handle a realistic change in functional requirements.
* Presenting conclusions and recommendations for the potential use of AI-assisted development within TOOS.

  

The project is designed for two students with complementary areas of focus:


**Student 1 – AI-assisted function development**: Function modeling, structured prompting, AI-supported code generation and implementation.


**Student 2 – AI-assisted testing and quality evaluation**: Test generation, independent verification, software quality measurements and evaluation methodology.

  

Both students will collaborate on the experimental design, development activities, analysis and final thesis report.


The expected outcome is a working prototype, an evidence-based comparison of development approaches and practical recommendations on where AI can improve software engineering efficiency without sacrificing quality.

**Education/program/focus**


We are looking for students pursuing a Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning or a closely related field.


A strong interest in software development and practical applications of AI is essential. Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas is advantageous:


* Generative AI, LLMs and prompt engineering.
* Software development and programming.
* Automated software testing and continuous integration.
* Requirements engineering or model-based development.
* Experimental evaluation and data analysis.

We value curiosity, analytical thinking and an interest in applying emerging technologies to real-world engineering challenges.

  

**Number of students**: 2 students working jointly on one thesis project.


**Start date for the thesis work**: To be agreed, preferably spring 2027.


**Estimated time required**: 20 weeks full-time, corresponding to 30 ECTS per student.


**Location**: TRATON R&D, Södertälje, Sweden.

**Contact persons and supervisors**


Industrial supervisor: To be confirmed.


Contact person: Thomas Edwall, Unit Manager CHIPPS Operating System | TGRECHV


Domain Cloud & Embedded Platform | EE Platform | TRATON Group R&D


Academic supervisor and examiner: Appointed by the students' university.

  


**Application:**  

Your application must include a CV, personal letter and transcript of grades

  

**A background check might be conducted for this position. We are conducting interviews continuously and may close the recruitment earlier than the date specified.**

title: Product Owner
description:
**About the role**
------------------


As Product Owner at Zendr you own one of our product domains end to end. You decide what we build and why and you make sure it lands with customers. Our developers work effectively with AI agents which means code gets written fast. That makes your role even more important. Knowing exactly what problem to solve and deciding quickly is what keeps the pace up and that is your job.


You won’t spend your days slicing work into tickets. You describe the customer problem, why it matters and what success looks like backed by real data. The developers and their agents own the solution. When questions come up you answer them the same day. When something is built you try it yourself and accept it against the evidence.


To do that well you need to know our product, our business and the freight industry deeply. You’ll visit customers every quarter, talk to them often and know your domain’s numbers. You will play a key role in making our product even better for both customers and internal users.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own a product domain: its priorities, its outcomes and the decisions that shape it
* Write sharp briefs: the problem, who has it, why it matters, success criteria and acceptance criteria in business language
* Use AI every day to research, analyse data, read legacy behaviour and draft faster and verify what it gives you
* Make product and policy decisions within a working day and log them so others can follow
* Review the decisions developers make along the way and step in when something is policy rather than detail
* Accept features on evidence by testing them yourself against the success criteria
* Visit customers at least once a quarter and stay close to support, sales and operations
* Help shape how a product team works when AI does much of the building

**About you**
-------------

#### **We are looking for someone with:**

* At least 5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager on technical products working closely with developers
* A completed three-year bachelor’s degree in a technical field
* Hands-on daily use of AI tools in your product work and examples you can show us
* Clear writing: problems, rules and acceptance criteria that others can act on without a meeting
* Comfort with data: you query it using SQL or similar rather than estimating
* The ability to decide quickly, own your calls and change course when the evidence says so
* Curiosity about customers and operations and a willingness to learn a complex domain from the ground up
* Fluent Swedish and English in speech and writing as parts of our domain operate in Swedish

#### **High value if you also bring:**

* Experience from smaller or fast-growing tech companies
* Experience from SaaS and ideally logistics, freight, e-commerce or ERP
* An understanding of APIs and integrations
* Experience working with teams that build with AI agents

**About Zendr**
---------------


Zendr is a fast-growing SaaS company developing cloud-based solutions for B2B freight. We take pride in our innovative platform and the passionate team that contributes to our success every day. At Zendr, collaboration and well-being are key – we offer a workplace where you can truly make an impact. We're proud of what we do and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. We believe it's important that you feel valued, engaged, and empowered to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly – both professionally and personally – while being part of building something meaningful.

### **What we offer**

* Real ownership: a domain that’s yours and decisions that are yours to make
* A short path from customer problem to live feature
* A growing tech team in Stockholm working closely with the rest of the business
* A competitive salary of SEK 50,000–60,000 per month based on your background and experience plus a benefits package

### **Our Hiring Process**


We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:

* Application review - We'll review your application promptly and get back to you as soon as we can.
* First conversation - An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
* Case & discussion - A practical case followed by a conversation where you walk us through your reasoning and approach. We'll share the details with you once you reach this step.
* Final meeting - Meet the team at our Stockholm office and talk through the role in detail to see if we are the right fit for each other.


From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time, because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.

#### **Additional information**


We review applications on a rolling basis, which means the position may be filled before the closing date.

**Start date:** As soon as possible

**Scope:** Full-time, permanent position

**Location:** Stockholm

**Language:** Fluent Swedish and English in speech and writing is required

title: Service Owner – Finance & Microsoft Dynamics 365 - McDonalds / Foodfolk
description:
Are you an experienced Service Owner, Application Owner, or Product Owner with a strong background in Finance and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance? We are looking for a driven and pragmatic finance IT professional to take end-to-end ownership of a business-critical finance IT portfolio and help shape its future direction.


In this role, you will work at the intersection of business and IT, combining operational ownership with strategic development. You will be a key driver in ensuring that the finance platform delivers value today while continuously evolving to meet future business needs.

**What McDonald's / Food Folk is offering you**


At Food Folk and McDonald's, all employees are equal, regardless of age, gender, and ethnicity. We want to make a difference and in many cases we are the first step in the career and an integration engine in society, something we are very proud of. At Food Folk / McDonald's, we believe that good food can also be sustainable – for our customers, producers and the environment.


In addition to a global, professional workplace with many great colleagues, you get pension, a yearly bonus, food allowance and a range of benefits. With many fun activities all year round, you and all employees will be involved and continue to grow with the Nordic region's largest restaurant chain!

**What you will do**


As Service Owner, you will have end-to-end ownership of the Finance IT portfolio, with a particular focus on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance. You will ensure that critical finance services are well managed and continuously developed, while also helping shape the long-term direction of the platform. The role combines operational responsibility with strategic development and requires you to move comfortably between business needs, IT priorities, vendors, and senior stakeholders.


You will work closely with the PMO and project organisation to bring new initiatives and implementations into the operational environment, while driving continuous improvement and digitalisation across the finance platform. You will also contribute to the ongoing development of IT Service Management, governance, and ways of working as the wider IT organisation continues to mature.


In the role, you will:

* **Own the Finance IT portfolio** – manage the full lifecycle of finance services, from new implementations and transition into operations to continuous improvement and future development.
* **Drive business and IT alignment** – act as a key link between Finance, IT, senior stakeholders, and external partners, ensuring priorities are understood, decisions are made, and issues are escalated and resolved.
* **Lead governance and service management** – ensure appropriate documentation, compliance, governance, processes, and ways of working according to service criticality, while contributing to the continued maturity of IT Service Management.
* **Manage partners, budget and performance** – oversee vendor relationships, governance, budget follow-up, and cost control across the finance IT portfolio.
* **Lead change and digitalisation** – drive cross-functional initiatives and identify practical opportunities for continuous improvement, automation, and AI that can create tangible value for the finance organisation.
* **Provide finance application expertise** – act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor on finance applications, combining a strong understanding of the business with the ability to navigate both operational and strategic priorities.

**What we are looking for**


We are looking for an experienced Finance IT professional who combines strong knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance with a broader understanding of finance processes, IT service management, and business needs. You have experience taking ownership of business-critical applications or services and are comfortable working across both strategic and operational levels.


You are used to working in a complex stakeholder environment and can build strong relationships across Finance, IT, senior leadership, and external partners. You bring structure and a pragmatic approach to governance, service management, and continuous improvement, while also being able to drive change and deliver results.


We expect you to have:

* Several years of experience as a Service Owner, Application Owner, Product Owner, or in a similar Finance IT role, with responsibility for business-critical applications or services.
* **S**olid expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and a good understanding of core finance processes, including financial accounting, controlling, reporting, budgeting, and master data management.
* A good understanding of ITSM, ITIL, governance, vendor management, and working in a cloud-based systems environment.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional initiatives and translating business needs into practical IT solutions, while combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Confident communicating and presenting to different audiences, including senior leadership, and experienced in building effective relationships across business, IT, and external partners.
* Experience with budgets, cost follow-up, vendors, and the ongoing management and performance of a Finance IT portfolio.

**Nice to have**


The following experience is not required, but would be considered an advantage:

* **ERP experience beyond Dynamics 365** – experience with other ERP platforms, such as SAP, is a plus. A strong understanding of finance and ERP processes is considered transferable to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance.
* **ITIL certification** – a formal ITIL certification or equivalent is valued, but not required.
* **Experience from a mature IT organisation** – experience from a larger organisation with established service management practices is an advantage. A background in consulting or agency work, combined with experience moving into a client-side role, is also relevant.

**About you**


You are a good listener who understands different perspectives, but you are also comfortable setting boundaries and making decisions when priorities compete.


You are driven, curious, and capable of operating with a high level of personal responsibility. At the same time, you are self-aware, know your limits, and are comfortable asking for support when needed.


You are confident enough to lead and challenge when necessary, while remaining humble and collaborative. You can move naturally between business stakeholders, IT specialists, vendors, and senior leadership, adapting your communication to the audience.


Most importantly, you enjoy making things happen. You can translate business needs into practical IT priorities and help turn change into tangible results.

**Location**


The primary location is **Stockholm, Sweden**.


We are also open to candidates based in **Malmö or Copenhagen**, with the possibility of working from our office in **Copenhagen**.


Regular presence in the office is an important part of the role. We are looking for someone who wants to be close to the team, the business, and the day-to-day operation.

**Application**


As interviews and selection are conducted on an ongoing basis, we kindly ask you to submit your application as soon as possible.

**About McDonald’s & Food Folk**


McDonald’s is the largest restaurant chain in the Nordics, serving iconic products like the Big Mac and their world-famous fries to 600,000 guests every day. McDonald’s has approximately 20,000 employees in more than 430 restaurants, all delivering a great restaurant experience to their guests. Most of the McDonald’s restaurants are owned and operated by local franchisees.


Since 2017, Food Folk Group has owned the licensee rights for McDonald’s in the Nordics and is responsible for developing McDonald’s in these markets. The Nordic headquarters organisation consists of 220 colleagues, and the organisation is built on a matrix structure, where most employees are working in Group functions.


McDonald’s has a high-performance culture, and we do everything in our power to deliver a great restaurant experience to our guests, no matter if you are working in a restaurant or at the headquarters.


In 2021, McDonald’s became the leading Quick Service Restaurant in each of the Nordic countries for the first time. System-wide sales exceed €1.5 billion, with more than 136 million customers served annually. Food Folk is the largest youth employer in the region, with around 20,000 restaurant employees and approximately 70 franchisees operating across four countries. There are ambitious plans to grow to 600 restaurants by 2030.


We believe in using our scale and reach responsibly, engaging customers, employees, franchisees, suppliers, and partners to make a positive impact in the communities we serve. We are proud of the progress made and remain committed to driving meaningful change across our markets.


Food Folk is an independent company holding a 20-year McDonald’s International Development Licence (“IDL”) to operate McDonald’s restaurants in the Nordics. Owned by the Hands Family since 2017, Food Folk oversees both restaurant operations and the associated real estate portfolio. The corporate organisation comprises around 250 colleagues, with offices in Copenhagen, Helsinki, Oslo, and Stockholm.

title: Network Security Specialist | SEB, Stockholm

As the banking industry continues its digital transformation, secure and resilient network services are more critical than ever. Our engineers play a key role in protecting SEB's infrastructure while enabling innovation and business growth. If you are passionate about network security and want to work with large-scale, business-critical environments, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.  



We are now looking for a Network Security Specialist to strengthen our team, with a focus on Firewalls, Routing/Switching and proxy technologies.  


**About the role**
* Design, implement, maintain and continuously improve SEB's global firewall infrastructure.
* Manage and develop network security services, including firewall policies, rule reviews, segmentation and security architecture.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex network and security incidents across firewalls, routing, switching and proxy environments.
* Collaborate with architects, security teams and infrastructure specialists to ensure secure and scalable network solutions.
* Support SEB's cloud transformation by integrating network security solutions across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Drive standardization, automation and operational improvements to increase efficiency and reduce risk.
* Participate in security reviews, change implementations and lifecycle management of network security platforms.

  


**To thrive in this role, we believe you have**

Required:
* Solid hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting firewalls in large enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of network security concepts, including:
* + Firewall management
	+ Network segmentation
	+ NAT
	+ VPN technologies
	+ Access control policies
* Experience with routing and switching technologies
* Understanding of proxy technologies and secure access solutions.
* Experience working with complex and business-critical network infrastructures.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

  



Meritorious:
* Experience with automation and scripting using Python, Ansible or similar tools.
* Experience with cloud networking and security in AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Experience with Linux environments and Git-based development workflows.
* Experience in leveraging AI-powered tools to drive tangible improvements in operations, security, and automation.

What We Expect:

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks and deliveries.

title: Customer Value Manager
description:
* Ansök senast: 29 november 2026
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

På Tre arbetar vi datadrivet för att skapa starkare kundrelationer och långsiktigt värde för både kunder och affären. Nu söker vi en **Customer Value Manager** till teamet Customer Value Management inom Consumer Market.


Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera kundvärde, affärsutveckling och datadrivna beslut för att påverka några av våra viktigaste affärsresultat. Du drivs av att förstå kundbeteenden, identifiera affärsmöjligheter och omsätta insikter till aktiviteter som stärker kundlojaliteten, minskar churn och ökar kundvärdet över tid.

**Om rollen**  

Som Customer Value Manager ansvarar du för att utveckla värdet i vår kundbas genom att minska churn och identifiera möjligheter till ökat kundvärde.


Tillsammans med Commercial, Marketing Automation, Online, Analytics & AI samt Save Desk utvecklar du kundresor, erbjudanden och aktiviteter som stärker kundlojaliteten och driver långsiktig lönsamhet. Genom analys, segmentering och datadrivna arbetssätt identifierar du vilka kundsegment vi ska prioritera, när vi ska agera och vilka insatser som skapar störst effekt på kundvärde och förlängningsgrad.


Rollen spänner från analys och hypotes till genomförande, uppföljning och affärsresultat. Du behöver inte själv vara Data Scientist, men du är van att arbeta nära data, analys och modeller och förstår hur insikter kan omsättas till kommersiella beslut och aktiviteter.


Vi befinner oss samtidigt på en utvecklingsresa där data, AI och automatisering blir en allt viktigare del av hur vi arbetar med kundutveckling. Därför söker vi dig som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens Customer Value Management på Tre.

**Du kan se fram emot att:**

* arbeta med några av våra viktigaste KPI:er inom churn, retention och kundvärde
* utveckla strategier, kundresor och aktiviteter som stärker kundlojaliteten
* använda kunddata, analyser och insikter som grund för kommersiella beslut
* samarbeta nära Commercial, Analytics & AI, Online, Marketing Automation och Save Desk
* bidra till att utveckla framtidens datadrivna Customer Value Management på Tre

**Så här beskriver Fredrik sitt ledarskap**  

*"För mig handlar ledarskap om att skapa psykologisk trygghet och ge människor förutsättningar att lyckas. Vi verkar i en marknad som förändras snabbt, vilket kräver att vi vågar testa nytt, lära oss längs vägen och ibland misslyckas. Därför tror jag på ett ledarskap som bygger på öppenhet, tillit och nära samarbete. När människor känner sig trygga, motiverade och kan vara sig själva skapar vi också de bästa resultaten tillsammans."*


**Några av våra medarbetare**
-----------------------------

Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
*"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."*
Henrik Sundvall
Digital projektledare
*"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"*
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Vem är du?**  

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av Customer Value Management, CRM, retention eller liknande områden inom en abonnemangsbaserad verksamhet.


Du är analytisk, affärsdriven och van att arbeta nära data för att förstå kundbeteenden, identifiera möjligheter och prioritera insatser som skapar affärsvärde.

**Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av:**

* Customer Value Management, CRM eller retention
* segmentering och datadrivet kundarbete
* testning, A/B-testning och effektmätning
* churn-, retention- eller kundvärdesarbete
* att omsätta insikter till kommersiella aktiviteter
* erfarenhet av AI-drivna arbetssätt eller prediktiva modeller är meriterande.


Som person är du strukturerad, initiativtagande och resultatorienterad. Du trivs i tvärfunktionella samarbeten och motiveras av att se konkret effekt av det du driver.

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**  

Vi tar emot ansökningar via denna annons och håller intervjuer löpande. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill gärna att du bifogar ditt CV och svarar på några frågor i samband med ansökan.


Tester används som stöd för en objektiv bedömning i urvalet. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Bakgrundskontroll genomförs på slutkandidat.


**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* Friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrarlön, pension & försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
* Flexibla helgdagar och sex dagar extra ledigt per år
* Hundzon & gym i 3huset
* Subventionerad lunch
* Förmånliga rabatter på cyklar, kollektivtrafik och elbilar
* Generösa bonusmodeller eller provisioner
**Om företaget**
