title: Manager, Audience Insights and Impact
description:
**FIXED-TERM FULL-TIME JOB VACANCY**  

**MANAGER, AUDIENCE INSIGHTS AND IMPACT**  

**AUDIENCE ENGAGEMENT DIVISION**  

**Location: London, Berlin, Brussels, Stockholm or Amsterdam**  

**Application Deadline: 22 November 2026**



Human Rights Watch (HRW) is seeking a **Manager, Audience Insights and Impact** to help us better understand our global audiences and strengthen the reach and impact of our communications.  

  

Combining audience research, data analysis, and impact measurement, the successful candidate will turn data into actionable insights that shape editorial decisions, distribution strategies and advocacy communications around our human rights work.  

  

You will establish consistent measurement and reporting practices across HRW's outreach efforts, helping communications teams understand not just how our content performs, but who it reaches, who it doesn't, how audiences respond, and what we need to adapt to drive increased ambition and impact.  

  

This fixed-term one-year role is new and sits within the Audience Engagement division of HRW's Communications Department, reporting to the Associate Director of Audience Engagement, and will work closely with colleagues across the Communications Department.  

  

Candidates must be based within commuting distance of HRW's offices in Amsterdam, Berlin, Brussels, London or Stockholm and able to work from their local office as needed.


**Responsibilities:**


**Audience Insights**


* Lead audience research and analysis, using quantitative and qualitative methods to understand priority audiences, their needs, behaviors, and information habits.
* Analyze performance across HRW's communications outreach, including earned media, website, social channels, video, newsletters, and other digital products.
* Translate findings into recommendations for distribution strategies across functions, including content choices, formats, and channels.
* Identify changes in audience behavior and the media landscape that affect HRW's communications, including search, AI-driven discovery, and emerging platforms.


**Measurement and impact**


* Develop shared KPIs, benchmarks and measurement frameworks aligned with HRW's communications objectives across channels and languages.
* Evaluate priority investigations, reports and campaigns using performance data and qualitative evidence; work with colleagues – including in Advocacy and Research – to assess communications' contribution to wider outcomes.
* Support practical testing and experimentation, ensuring lessons inform future editorial and campaign planning.


**Reporting, systems and collaboration**


* Build and maintain dashboards and concise reporting that bring together earned-media, web, social, video, and email insights, with clear recommendations for teams and leadership.
* Improve tracking, tagging, data quality and reporting standards; provide analysis for priority campaigns and donor or fundraising requirements.
* Work with managers, editors and outreach colleagues to embed insights into decision-making; strengthen data literacy through guidance and training.
* Work with vendors and colleagues to improve analytics tools and promote responsible, privacy-conscious use of audience data.


**Qualifications:**


**Education:**A bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.


**Experience:**At least five years' relevant experience in audience insights, digital analytics, communications research, impact evaluation, or a related field.


**Essential Skills**

* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, including audience research, segmentation and interpretation of performance metrics.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4, social media analytics and data visualization or dashboard tools (e.g. Data Studio, Power BI or Tableau).
* Ability to develop KPIs, explain the limits of impact evidence and communicate findings clearly to non-specialists.
* Excellent writing, presentation, collaboration and project management skills; fluency in English and commitment to HRW's mission.


**Desired Skills**

* Experience in advocacy impact evaluation or monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL), and in multilingual or multi-market analysis.
* Familiarity with media-monitoring or listening tools, Sprout Social, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SQL or other advanced analysis tools.
* Proficiency with traditional media and PR tracking tools such as Meltwater, PRNewswire, Cision, TalkWalker, and Newswhip.
* Experience in project management software such as Asana, Monday.com or similar products.
* Knowledge of digital discoverability, experience managing research or analytics vendors, or proficiency in an additional HRW language.


**Other:** Applicants for this position must possess valid work authorization for the location where they wish to be based.


**Salary and Benefits:** HRW seeks exceptional applications and offers competitive compensation and employer paid benefits.


**How to Apply:** Please apply by **22** **November 2026,** by visiting our online job portal at careers.hrw.org and attaching a resume and cover letter, preferably as a PDF file.



No calls or email inquiries, please. Only complete applications will be reviewed, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



If you are experiencing technical difficulties with your application submission, or if you require a disability-related accommodation, please email recruitment@hrw.org. Due to the large response, application submissions via email will not be accepted and inquiries regarding the status of applications will go unanswered.


***Human Rights Watch*** *is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Human Rights Watch does not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, or criminal record. We welcome all kinds of diversity. Our employees include people who are parents and nonparents, the self-taught and university educated, and from a wide span of socio-economic backgrounds and perspectives on the world. Human Rights Watch is an equal opportunity employer.*

  

***Human Rights Watch*** *is an international human rights monitoring and advocacy organization known for its in-depth investigations, its incisive and timely reporting, its innovative and high-profile advocacy campaigns, and its success in changing the human rights-related policies and practices of influential governments and international institutions.*

title: Team Lead Information Excellence
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**  

AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.

 **Jobbeskrivning**  

Som Team Lead för vårt Information Excellence-team i Göteborg, inom segmentet Places, kombinerar du en konsultroll i kunduppdrag med ansvar för ledarskap, coachning, affärs- och tjänsteutveckling samt marknadsarbete.


Du delar din tid mellan att driva och arbeta i kunduppdrag inom Information Excellence och att leda ett mindre team bestående av fem medarbetare, däribland BIM-samordnare och seniora specialister. Teamet har uppdrag inom BIM-samordning och informationssamordning inom fastigheter och anläggningar.


I rollen stöttar du teamets utveckling, skapar engagemang och bidrar till goda förutsättningar för både individers och gruppens framgång. Balansen mellan kunduppdrag, affärsutveckling och Team Lead-ansvar utvecklas över tid och anpassas i dialog med din chef utifrån verksamhetens behov, teamets förutsättningar och aktuella affärs- och utvecklingsinitiativ.


Genom din närvaro i kunduppdrag får du värdefulla insikter om marknadens behov och framtida utveckling. Du använder dessa för att säkerställa att teamets kompetens och erbjudanden ligger i framkant, identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och omsätta erfarenheter från projekt till utvecklade tjänster, metoder och arbetssätt. Du bygger långsiktiga kundrelationer och bidrar aktivt till att skapa nya affärer.


Tillsammans med teamet stärker du AFRYs position som en ledande rådgivare inom informationshantering och digital transformation. Rollen utgår från kontoret, men möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån finns utifrån dialog med chef.

**Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden**

* Verka som rådgivare, uppdragsledare eller specialist i kunduppdrag och projekt inom Information Excellence
* Vara en förebild i konsultrollen samt inom affärsmannaskap och teknisk kompetens
* Initiera och driva utvecklingen av nya tjänster, erbjudanden och arbetssätt
* Identifiera kundbehov och affärsmöjligheter genom aktiv kunddialog och nära samverkan i projekt
* Bygga nya kundrelationer och vidareutveckla långsiktiga samarbeten med befintliga kunder.
* Leda, coacha och utveckla teamets medarbetare
* Bidra till en inkluderande och utvecklande arbetsmiljö
* Bidra till resursplanering, kompetensutveckling och rekrytering för att säkerställa teamets långsiktiga framgång
* Skapa tydlighet kring mål, prioriteringar och förväntningar samt följa upp medarbetarnas utveckling, prestation och arbetssituation

  

**Kvalifikationer** **Vem är du?**


Som Team Lead inom Information Excellence kombinerar du gedigen konsultkompetens med ledarskap och affärsutveckling. Du trivs i en varierad roll där du får möjlighet att kombinera kunduppdrag med att leda och utveckla ett team.


Du är en relationsskapande person som naturligt bygger förtroende och etablerar starka samarbeten, både med nya och befintliga kunder. Med god marknadsförståelse fångar du upp kundernas behov och omsätter dem till värdeskapande tjänster och erbjudanden.


Som ledare inspirerar, coachar och utvecklar du människor genom ett närvarande och engagerande ledarskap. Du arbetar strukturerat och lösningsorienterat, med förmåga att planera, prioritera och driva arbetet framåt i en föränderlig miljö.

**För att lyckas och trivas i rollen har du med dig:**

* Minst sju års erfarenhet som konsult inom Information Excellence, BIM, informationshantering eller närliggande område, där du självständigt har lett och genomfört uppdrag
* God förståelse för bygg-, fastighets- och anläggningsbranschens processer, aktörer och utmaningar
* Minst två års erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla människor, antingen i en formell chefsroll eller som exempelvis teamledare, uppdragsledare eller annan informell ledare
* Erfarenhet av affärsutveckling, kundrelationer och nätverkande, med förmåga att identifiera kundbehov och omsätta dem i uppdrag och erbjudanden
* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom BIM, informationshantering, bygg, fastighet eller motsvarande område
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
* Mycket god kunskap om informationshantering och informationsstyrning enligt ISO 19650, med erfarenhet av att omsätta beställar- och projektkrav till informationskrav, arbetssätt och digitala leveranser
* Praktisk erfarenhet av relevanta BIM-, modellerings-, gransknings- och CDE-verktyg, exempelvis Revit, Solibri, Navisworks och Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) eller motsvarande
* God förståelse för openBIM/IFC, informationsstruktur och klassifikation, samt erfarenhet av modellgranskning, BIM-samordning och kvalitetssäkring av digitala informationsleveranser
* Erfarenhet av att leda multidisciplinär BIM- och informationssamordning i fastighetsprojekt

**Det är meriterande ifall du även har:**

* Högskole- eller universitetsexamen inom relevant område
* Erfarenhet av implementering av CDE, dokumenthanteringssystem eller andra digitala plattformar i större projekt eller organisationer
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla nya digitala tjänster, automatiserade arbetssätt eller AI-baserade erbjudanden
* Erfarenhet av Digital Twins och Data Governance
* Erfarenhet av informationshantering och digitala informationsleveranser för förvaltning och Asset Management

  

**Ytterligare information** **Välkommen med din ansökan, sista ansökningsdag är 2026-12-01.** Vi arbetar med löpande rekrytering, vilket innebär att rollen kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.  

  

**Kontaktperson för frågor:**  

Anna Eckerstig, Service Area Manager  

anna.eckerstig@afry.com  

  

För samtliga rekryteringar på AFRY genomförs som grund alltid en ID-kontroll, referenstagning samt verifiering av utbildning. Eftersom tjänsten kan komma att verka inom säkerhetsklassade områden kan det bli aktuellt med säkerhetsprövning med eventuell registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

*På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen*

description:
Vi på Iver brinner för innovationer och god laganda, vi är särskilt intresserade av dig som gillar att tänka nytt och dela med dig av dina tankar. Vi söker en Business Development Manager till vår vertikal Financial Services & Fintech som vill bidra till bättre IT-lösningar för våra kunder. Är du vår nya kollega? We empower our Nordic society Iver är en ledande nordisk helhetsleverantör av molnbaserade IT-tjänster med spetskompetens inom drift, cybersäkerhet, cloud och innovation.
  
  

Våra tjänster är kritiska inte bara för våra kunder utan för digitaliseringen av samhället i stort. Med huvudkontor i Stockholm verkar Iver främst i Norden med en agenda att fortsätta expandera. Iver omsätter drygt 3 miljarder SEK och har cirka 1 300 anställda som arbetar på ett av våra 23 kontor i Norden. Din roll på Iver Vår kundbas är bred med representation inom flera branscher och sektorer.
  
  

Med djup förståelse för kundens verksamhet driver vi digital transformation med ett gemensamt intresse för hur vi kan utveckla kundens affär. Nu söker vi dig med lång erfarenhet av att leverera IT-lösningar till kunder inom vertikalen Financial Services och Fintech. Som Business Developer inom Financial Services & Fintech kommer du att utnyttja din strategiska säljexpertis för att identifiera viktiga beslutsfattare i branschen. Du skapar värdefulla affärsmöjligheter och kvalificerar dem effektivt.
  
  

Med din erfarenhet inom sektorn har du en god förståelse för de regulatoriska, säkerhetsmässiga och affärskritiska krav som IT-miljöer inom finans måste uppfylla. IT-lösningar för Financial Services och Fintech måste möta höga krav på regelefterlevnad, säkerhet och tillgänglighet. Det kan exempelvis handla om regelverk som PCI DSS, DORA, GDPR, penningtvättsdirektiv (AML) samt Finansinspektionens föreskrifter. Kunder inom sektorn efterfrågar robusta och skalbara lösningar för: Säker molntransformation Open Banking och API-ekosystem Realtidsbetalningar och transaktionshantering Dataanalys och AI-driven beslutsstöd Identitetshantering och Zero Trust-arkitektur Cybersäkerhet och kontinuitetshantering Förståelse för digitalisering av kärnbanksplattformar, moderna betalningslösningar, embedded finance och regulatoriskt styrd IT-drift är avgörande.
  
  

Med en gedigen förståelse för försäljningsprocessen hanterar du hela cykeln – från prospektering till stängning – med fokus på långsiktiga strategiska partnerskap. Vad erbjuder vi dig? På Iver får du möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste tekniken och vara med på en spännande tillväxtresa. Vi är inkluderande och strävar efter ett genuint samarbete mot gemensamma mål.
  
  

Inom Iver finns stora möjligheter till utveckling och vi finns här för att inspirera dig till att nå dina yrkesmässiga mål. Vi står bakom dig när du vill lära dig mer inom ditt specialområde, ledarskap eller nya områden. Hos Iver är du också en del av ett ambitiöst och innovativt företag, vilket innebär att förbättra, testa, utvärdera och våga ändra hur vi gör saker är viktiga ingredienser för att vi ska utvecklas. Vi på Iver ger samma löfte till våra kollegor som till våra kunder.
  
  

Löftet är att alltid vara ”beside you”, ”behind you” och ”before you”. Vi kallar det för "The Iver way". Förmåner hos oss: Kollektivavtal & trygga villkor Hybridarbete Friskvårdsbidrag Terminalglasögon ⏳ Tidsbank - 24 h extra ledighet/år Privat sjukvårdsförsäkring Tjänstepension (ITP) & flexpension Vi söker dig som har: 5–7 års erfarenhet av framgångsrik tjänsteförsäljning inom IT-drift/outsourcing. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att skapa nya kundrelationer och stänga affärer.
  
  

En etablerad närvaro och ett välutvecklat och starkt kontaktnät inom Bank och Fintech. Förmågan att förstå kunders behov och utveckla innovativa lösningar. En utpräglad hunter-profil med energi och vinnarmentalitet. Flytande svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift samt B-körkort.
  
  

**Placeringsort:** Iver finns på 23 orter i Norden. För denna roll ser vi att du utgår från vårt huvudkontor i Solna. Övrig information: Vi har kunder inom alla branscher och sektorer inklusive säkerhetsklassad verksamhet, därför genomför vi bakgrundskontroller i samtliga av våra rekryteringsprocesser. Sök till oss! Urval sker löpande, tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.

title: Security AI Engineer
description:
**Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Security AI Engineer to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Managed Security Services domain.**

##### **About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company**


Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.


Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.


Today, we are around 450 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Security AI Engineer who wants to make a difference in our Managed Security Services domain.

##### **Managed Security Services**


Truesec helps customers globally with Attack Prediction Services, Vulnerability Management Services and Managed Detection & Response services for IT and OT environments. Our services are all delivered by skilled security analysis teams that conducts 24/7 attack monitoring, threat hunting, threat intelligence analysis, and threat remediation. Our team of experts works tirelessly to identify and prevent cyber breaches, and to help increase our customers’ proactive cybersecurity defenses. Our goal is to be an extension of our customers’ IT organizations, customizing a combination of capabilities and tooling, tailored to prevent cyber attacks in the most efficient way.

##### **The Role**


As a Security AI Engineer in Managed Security Services, you will help shape the next generation of security operations. You will turn operational SOC needs into secure, production-ready AI solutions across alert analysis, enrichment, orchestration and response. You will work closely with SOC analysts, service architects, security engineers and developers to ensure that AI-powered automation and agentic workflows create measurable value while keeping human expertise and operational control at the center.

* Design, develop and improve AI and deterministic agents and agentic workflows for SOC operations.
* Build prompts, tools, knowledge sources, RAG capabilities and integrations across security platforms, internal systems, APIs and AI services.
* Evaluate solution quality, accuracy, security, reliability and operational impact before production use.
* Lead AI-supported security solutions from technical design and experimentation through production deployment and continuous improvement.
##### **Your Potential Background**


You are an experienced AI, machine learning or data engineer with a strong understanding of cybersecurity and modern SOC operations. You enjoy turning complex operational needs into practical, production-ready AI solutions. You combine hands-on engineering experience with sound security judgment, can explain technical design decisions clearly and are comfortable guiding colleagues in a cross-functional environment.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong experience in data engineering, machine learning or applied data science, including working with data pipelines, data and feature preparation, model development, evaluation and production-oriented ML workflows.
* Strong software engineering, scripting and integration skills using Python, PowerShell, APIs or comparable technologies.
* Practical understanding of cybersecurity engineering, SOC operations and platforms such as SIEM, EDR, XDR or SOAR.
* Experience taking secure technical solutions from design and experimentation into reliable production use.
* Experience mentoring engineers, guiding technical decisions and helping operational teams
 **Bonus Skills:**

* Hands-on experience designing, developing and evaluating AI agents, LLM-based applications, RAG solutions or comparable AI-powered workflows.
* Experience with prompt engineering, agent orchestration, knowledge grounding, tool integration and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience with Microsoft security technologies, cloud platforms or workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of threat detection, threat hunting, incident response or security data engineering.
*Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.*

##### **Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future**


If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.


So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

title: Research Infrastructure Specialist
description:
### **Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?**

Robust data infrastructure, reproducibility, and standardized computational pipelines are the backbone of modern biological research. As part of SciLifeLab, a unique nation-wide research infrastructure and research community, the CRISPR Functional Genomics unit at Karolinska Institutet is looking for a Research Infrastructure Specialist in Bioinformatics and Data Stewardship

### **Your mission**


You will spend roughly half of your time on building and maintaining reproducible pipelines for the in-depth analysis of high-throughput CRISPR gene-perturbation data. The remaining half will be dedicated to routine data administration throughout the data lifecycle, including metadata annotation, FAIR compliance for data sharing, and long-term archiving. Within this allocation, you will also support CFG and its users with day-to-day data analysis, management, and project delivery.


More specifically, you will engage in the following areas:

* Pipeline Engineering & Quality Control: Implement, benchmark, and maintain containerized workflows (e.g., Nextflow/Snakemake) to automate standard QC of pooled CRISPR screens – standard readouts, single-cell based readouts, and soon optical pooled screening readouts.
* Hit Calling & Statistical Frameworks: Apply statistical models and algorithms to prioritize candidate hits across pooled CRISPR screening datasets, including base-editing datasets.
* Metadata Curation & Archival Infrastructure: Design and enforce structured metadata schemes, manage raw and processed data uploads to public/institutional repositories, and establish audit-ready archiving procedures to maintain long-term FAIR compliance.
* User Consultation & Project Management: Conduct technical consultations with external and internal research groups to define analysis requirements, troubleshoot user data issues, and deliver clear summary reports and interactive visualizations.
* Internal Computational Support: Maintain webpages and support the team in all computer- and virtual environment-related tasks.

### **Eligibility requirements**


For employment as Research Infrastructure Specialist at Karolinska Institutet, the eligibility requirements stated in the Guidelines for non-teaching positions at Karolinska Institutet are applied in relation to the established profile of employment.


To be eligible for an employment as Research Infrastructure Specialist the applicant must have demonstrated research expertise and been awarded a PhD or a qualification from a foreign higher education institution deemed equivalent to a Swedish PhD. The applicant must also have demonstrated technological and methodological expertise.


In addition to these minimal requirements, eligible candidates need to meet the following requirements:

* PhD in Bioinformatics or Molecular Biosciences with at least three years of full-time wet-lab experience, and at least three years of full-time computational work.
* Proven track record in analyzing pooled CRISPR screening data, as well as single-cell data and spatial omics datasets with and without a perturbation context. Experience in image analysis and segmentation for OPS/spatial transcriptomics is viewed favourably.
* Proficiency in Python, R, and Unix/Linux (Bash) for omics data processing, quality control, statistical modeling, and interactive data visualization (e.g., Shiny or HTML-based dashboards).
* Experience with backend databases/UI, drive releases, CI/CD, deployment, and production readiness of scientific applications.
* Practical skills in High-Performance Computing (HPC) such as NAISS, or cloud environments using version control, containerization, and automated workflow managers.
* Experience with version control, Git/Github, structured code, and automated testing.
* Strong commitment to routine data administration, metadata tracking, and enforcing strict institutional compliance for FAIR data sharing and long-term archival.
* Fluency in English (written and spoken) with a client- and service-oriented approach to supporting researchers, managing user projects, and documenting computational pipelines.
* Familiarity with applying off-the-shelf biological foundation models and integrating LLMs/agentic workflows to automate routine bioinformatics tasks and data curation is advantageous.

### **Assessment criteria**


Experience or expertise in any of the following areas will be considered an advantage, with particular emphasis placed on candidates who demonstrate a strong commitment to service, infrastructure maintenance, and routine data stewardship:

* Routine Data Stewardship & FAIR Compliance: Demonstrated experience in enforcing structured metadata schemas, handling routine bulk data submissions to public/institutional repositories, and maintaining strict, audit-ready data archives.
* Pipeline Maintenance & Execution: Proficiency in maintaining, troubleshooting, and executing existing containerized workflows (Snakemake, Nextflow, Docker/Singularity) for standard quality control.
* Standardized CRISPR & Omics Processing: Practical experience running established hit-calling frameworks (e.g., MAGeCK) and standard single-cell/spatial omics processing pipelines for external users.
* Client-Oriented Technical Support: A proven track record of acting in a service or core-facility capacity, including troubleshooting user data issues, consulting on standard experimental designs, and generating visually appealing and functional summary reports (Shiny or HTML dashboards).
* Cross-Functional Wet-Lab Knowledge: A strong background in the practical application of wet-lab methodologies that enables effective communication with experimental researchers and practical troubleshooting of user-generated data.
* General IT & Administrative Support: Willingness and technical ability to manage day-to-day internal group support, including maintaining web pages, updating documentation, and assisting colleagues with basic computer-related tasks.
* Applied AI Tooling for Automation: Practical experience integrating LLMs or agentic workflows specifically to automate routine bioinformatics tasks, pipeline documentation, or metadata curation.


After an overall assessment of the expertise and merits of the applicants in relation to the subject area, Karolinska Institutet will determine which of them has the best potential to contribute to a positive development of the activities at KI.

### **What do we offer?**


A creative, international and inspiring environment with wide-ranging expertise and interests. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Here, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. At KI, you get to meet researchers working with a wide range of specialisms and methods, giving you ample opportunity to exchange knowledge and experience with the various scientific fields within medicine and health. It is the crossover collaborations, which have pushed KI to where it is today, at the forefront of global research. Several of the people you meet in healthcare are educated at KI. A close relationship with the health care providers is important for creating groundbreaking top quality education and research. Karolinska Institutet is also a state university, which entitles you to several good benefits through our collective agreement.


CFG encourages personal and professional growth through access to courses, workshops, conferences, and specialized training in computational biology, functional genomics, and data science. We foster a flexible and supportive work culture, emphasizing collaboration, mentoring, and peer learning. While this position is initially limited to one year, it is anticipated to be advertised as a permanent position, and the current holder will be encouraged to apply, contingent on strong performance during the first year.

**Location:** Biomedicum, Solna


Karolinska Institutet Research Infrastructure
  

SciLifeLab CRISPR Functional Genomics
  

New Career Path for Research Infrastructure Specialists

### **Application**


We prefer that Your application is written in English, but You can also apply in Swedish. An application must contain the following documents: PhD certificate, resumé, qualifications presented in accordance with Karolinska Institutet's qualifications portfolio for research infrastructure specialist/senior research infrastructure specialist.


KI applies individual and differentiated salary setting in accordance with our collective agreements RALS and RALS-T. The application is to be submitted through the Varbi recruitment system.


Welcome with your application latest 2026-11-30.

**Want to make a difference? Join us and contribute to better health for all!**

title: Senior Data Scientist – Build the AI That Powers Life-Saving Medicine Production
description:
**Location** Södertälje, Stockholm County, Sweden **Job ID** R-263885 **Date posted** 09/11/2026
  
Data, Analytics & AI, Sweden Operations - Södertälje, Sweden


*Do you want your models, agents and AI systems to run in the factory that makes medicines for millions of patients?* At AstraZeneca, we follow the science and put patients first. We are building the next generation of AI in pharmaceutical manufacturing and supply, and we are looking for a Senior Data Scientist who can help us take it from promising prototype to trusted production reality.


**About the role**


Södertälje is one of the largest sites in AstraZeneca’s global network and a recognised World Economic Forum Global Lighthouse for digital manufacturing. Sweden Operations is now moving beyond individual predictive models towards connected, AI-enabled operations: decision support that senses what is happening across the value chain, reasons about it and recommends or takes action, with people in control.


As Senior Data Scientist in the Data, Analytics & AI team, part of Strategy & Performance, you will be a technical leader in that shift. You will work with colleagues across Inbound, Manufacturing, Quality, Outbound, Maintenance, Supply and Production Planning to turn complex operational problems into AI solutions that are reliable, explainable and compliant, and that people actually use.


**What you’ll do**


* **Design and build AI solutions end to end.** Combine machine learning, optimisation, simulation and generative AI to solve real operational problems, from forecasting and anomaly detection to document intelligence and process optimisation.
* **Develop LLM and agentic AI applications.** Build retrieval-augmented and agent-based systems that work with our data, tools and procedures, with rigorous evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design.
* **Frame the problem before the model.** Translate unstructured business challenges into the right analytical approach, including when the answer is a simple model rather than a complex one.
* **Take solutions into production.** Own the path from prototype to a monitored, maintained service using modern MLOps/LLMOps practices on our cloud and data platforms.
* **Make AI trustworthy.** Build quality, explainability, validation and documentation into the work so that it meets GxP, data integrity and regulatory compliance.
* **Influence.** Communicate results, uncertainty and limitations clearly to stakeholders from the shop floor to senior leadership, and help them decide where AI will and will not add value.
* **Keep the team ahead.** Follow research and tooling developments, test what is useful, and bring it into our ways of working.

**Who you are**


You are curious, rigorous and pragmatic. You like hard, ambiguous problems, but you care more about measurable impact than about novelty.


**Essential**


* Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, physics, operations research or a related quantitative field.
* Several years of experience delivering data science solutions into production, with a track record of business or scientific impact.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with solid software engineering practices, including Git-based version control, testing and code review.
* Strong data engineering skills, including building and maintaining reliable data pipelines, working with complex data sources, and ensuring data quality for analytics and AI applications.
* Deep knowledge of machine learning and statistics, including supervised and unsupervised learning, with experience in some of time series, forecasting or deep learning, and sound judgement on model choice, validation and uncertainty.
* Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including RAG, tool calling, and agentic workflows and orchestration, with a disciplined approach to evaluation, regression testing, and monitoring.
* Experience deploying and operating models and AI services in a cloud environment, including CI/CD, containerisation, monitoring, and pipeline orchestration.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder skills, and the ability to explain technical work in business language.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar, following best practices for code review, testing, and security.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

**Desirable**


* Optimisation, simulation, digital twin or process modelling experience; computer vision or multimodal AI.
* Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, life sciences or another regulated environment (GxP, validation, data integrity).
* Knowledge of responsible AI, model governance and risk management, including the EU AI Act.
* Experience with Snowflake or similar data platforms.
* Experience coaching or leading other data scientists.
* Swedish language skills.
* Product management skills, for example shaping value cases, prioritising a backlog and working with business owners to drive adoption.

**How we work**


We follow the science: we test our assumptions, measure what matters and share what we learn. We put patients first: reliable supply of quality medicines is the reason every model we build exists. We play to win and do the right thing: we set ambitious goals, and we never trade away quality, safety or integrity to reach them. We are entrepreneurial: we try new ideas quickly and learn from them, and we are happy to retire what does not work.


**Why AstraZeneca?**


You will work on problems with real consequences, with access to large-scale, high-quality operational data and a company that has made AI a strategic priority across the whole business. You will join an international, collaborative environment with strong opportunities to learn, to publish or present your work and to grow your career. Diversity and inclusion are at our core, so that everyone can bring their whole self to work.


**What’s next?**


Apply with your CV and a short cover letter **as one combined document** no later than **November 19, 2026**. In your letter, tell us about one AI or data science solution you took into real use: the problem, your approach, how you evaluated it, and what you would do differently. If you have public repositories or a portfolio, please include a link.Join us, and help turn data and AI into better, faster and more reliable medicines for patients. We look forward to hearing from you.

Work-Life Balance

title: Senior AWS Solutions Architect
description:
**Pratar du flytande AWS?**
---------------------------

**(...och kan förklara det för våra kunder som inte gör det?)**


Som Solutions Architect blir du säkert uppvaktad av bolag som lovar allt från "spännande resor" till "agila miljöer". Vi tänkte kort och gott bara berätta hur det är att jobba på Alto.


Vi är en mindre oberoende AWS-partner i Stockholm (Advanced Tier Partner) med kunduppdrag på både nystartade startups till etablerade tech-bolag. Vi designar och bygger säkra och skalbara molnlösningar. Vi är förändringsbenägna, nyfikna, vetgiriga och har roligt på vägen. Och vi gillar att fira framgångar! Senast firade vi två kollegor som blivit AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

**Vad du kommer att göra**


Du kommer att ha en central, strategisk roll hos oss. Du stöttar oss med teknisk kompetens i kundmöten, implementerar lösningar, leder workshops och designar lösningar åt våra kunder.

**Vem vi letar efter**


AI transformerar just nu systemutvecklingen. Med din tekniska grund förväntas du vilja utforska och driva den tekniken tillsammans med oss.


Du har förmodligen en akademisk bakgrund och har spenderat några år i arkitektur- eller seniora teknikroller. Då flera av våra kunduppdrag innefattar samhällskritiska system med säkerhetsklassning är svenskt medborgarskap är ett formellt krav för rollen. Erfarenhet av startups/Scaleups och produktbolag är ett plus, likaså om du redan sitter på en AWS-certifiering. Att du är van vid att kommunicera med både tekniker och icke-tekniska intressenter ser vi som en självklarhet.

**Livslångt lärande, enkelhet och omtanke**


På Alto delar vi kunskap. Så vi hoppas att även du delar med dig av dina erfarenheter och insikter. I gengäld lovar vi en miljö där vi sponsrar din egen fortsatta utbildning och dina certifieringar. Vi firar, analyserar problem utan prestige och bjuder varandra på tekniska djupdykningar.

**Vi erbjuder dig:**

Korta beslutsvägar.

Möjlighet till delägarskap.

Chansen att prägla Altos kultur och struktur i en fas där varje medarbetare gör verklig skillnad.

Roliga uppdrag inom den senaste AI/Cloud tekniken.


Vi har en stark företagskultur som bygger på omtanke, enkelhet och livslång lärande, där alla blir sedda, hörda och accepterade som den man är.


Vi har ett trevligt kontor på Slottsbacken där det bjuds på tekniksnack och onsdagsfrukost. Vi värdesätter flexibilitet och att du kan styra din egen tid men tror också på värdet att ses och samarbeta fysiskt under veckorna.


Vår rekryteringsprocess är enkel. Du ansöker genom att svara på några frågor och varken CV eller personligt brev behövs. Vill du presentera dig i videoformat, kul! Men inte heller det är något krav.


Vid eventuella frågor kontakta Rekryteringsansvarig: linda.stuve@alto.se
